svg.title: Cloud droplets over fresh and salt water in the Π Chamber
svg.desc: The Π Chamber’s two-cloud emblem identifies the facility. Measured cloud droplet concentration rises from the fresh-water to the salt-water experiment. Fitting humidity separately to each haze population predicts a decline on the same scale. Beside the salt-water endpoints, a denser cluster of solid blue droplets represents the measurement and a sparser cluster of outlined droplets represents the simulation.
